info.title: NERP API
info.description:
The REST API the NERP web app uses, open to other systems through API keys.

Create a key under **API & webhooks** and send it as `Authorization: Bearer nerp_…`. A key acts as the employee who made it, with their access rights, limited to its scopes, and is limited to 600 requests a minute. Errors come as `{"error": {"code", "message"}}` with a 4xx status.

This reference lists the main endpoints; everything under the same areas (`/crm`, `/tasks`, `/projects`, `/users`, `/departments`, `/files`) is reachable with the matching scope.
